english: A tall stone mural stands before you.
Three serpentine figures carved and painted into the surface.
Each coiled and intertwined with the others.
The colors are faint. But still there- greens, reds, yellows.
Highly detailed, yet brutish. Ancient techniques.
This was made by skilled hands during the Divine Era.
This is connected. The city. The wall.
You approach the Whitemane mural once more.
Three serpents frozen in their eternal dance.
What's the meaning behind the mural?
The top serpent has sharp teeth. Predatory.
The middle one appears more serpentine. Elegant.
The bottom one has unusual markings.
The Whitemane believed in divine triads.
Two serpents stretching from a singular point - one creature with many dual faces.
Only in balance between the two, can the soul retain its divinity.
Further down this path there should be an actual temple. Find it. Learn more about these noble creatures.
It is a pointer- a guide towards the temple you visited further down this path.
There's a ton of these all over the place.
You've either got snail memorabilia or these lion-styled pieces.
From what I learned in school, it was snails first, then lion, then trolls, then humans.
Don't you dare stage a coup.
Humans will never fail their grasp of this city. Never!
Unlike every other creature in known history?
Do what you do. Then let's keep moving. The southern tunnels are always filled with scary shit.
And we really don't wanna run into that fucking Roper again.
Worn by time but still detailed.
The Whitemane knew how to work stone.
A garbled mess of vocality. Its waves too faint.
Come back to this. To the wall.
You sense it. The crack in the wall.
Once more that voice carries through. Faint and hoarse.
Ah. Time for this again. Great.
The voice in the wall is monotone and brittle.
As if it could SNAP at any point.
Why do I keep talking with you? Do you live in every wall in the city?
Do you have something to tell me?
I remember you saying something like that before. Uh. Anyway.
YES. THERE IS ONE THING TO SAY.
Please tell me what you have to say. (Feel a little annoyed.)
There is no response to your waiting.
ON THE OVERLOOK. WHERE THE BANE OF MY PEOPLE WATCHES OVER THE GREAT FLIP.
THERE SHE HAS ASKED FOR YOU.
Okay. I'll go find Iomestra. (Give the wall a pat.)
THE ONE WHO BINDS US. OUR FRIEND.
Alright, good. Just needed to make sure I heard you the first time.
Sweet. I know exactly where to look.
Does this overlook happen to be another wall?
So I need to go talk with another wall?
You're obviously already proficient at it. So might as well?
The crack disappears as quickly and esoterically as it came to.
I'm not sure what kind of strange derailment this is, or how it's connected in any way with the tea shop. But...
Fuck it, I'm actually intrigued now. Let's see if we can find this lady in the wall.
This is it. You've found yourself a HIDDEN SIDE QUEST.
While slightly distracting, honestly? Let's do it.
Whoever this Iomestra lady is, she'll probably have some pretty nifty secrets down there...
Conversations with walls have never been so productive.
You will uncover great secrets by following this lead.
It has nothing to do with the rest of your mission here, but if you wish to grow your esoteric knowledge this is exactly the path to tread.
E-Time to go find the next wall in this wall-talking quest of mine.
